title: Bug 648577: [IT] Subcontracting migration does not precheck bin-mandatory locations
summary: The IT subcontracting migration now prechecks legacy vendor and purchase-header locations for unsupported warehouse settings, such as bin mandatory. If any are found it stops with a single error listing every incompatible location and its enabled settings, and leaves migration data untouched.
key_points: Blocks migration when legacy vendor or purchase-header locations use unsupported warehouse settings
Reports every incompatible location and lists each enabled setting
Migration data stays untouched when the precheck fails
Errors collected during the precheck are handled explicitly and raised as one blocking error
Tests cover multiple locations, all unsupported settings, and migration stopping before vendor data is copied
quote: Block IT subcontracting migration when legacy vendor or purchase-header locations use unsupported warehouse settings.
